prompt: Composition: Single reading column, left aligned headings, marginal metadata, thin section rules. Build for this brief: A cultural venue; visitors browse works, plan visits and find events. Set headings in Poppins and reading text in Roboto; geometric heading with functional sans text. Use Marine and Coral: page #F7FCFF, text #113C50, accent #B73545, secondary surface #E5F3F8, text on accent #FFFFFF. Use body 20px, heading 36px, line height 1.75, reading measure at most 60ch, gap 24px, content width at most 1440px and item radius 8px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
